proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6582 dola explicitly gives Prakrit ḍola eye, Oriya doḷā/ḍoḷā pupil and Marathi ḍoḷā eye. These western ḍoḷo/ḍoḷā eye forms match that eye branch; Marathi or other regional transmission remains open. Exact survey form ḍoḷā is preserved.
